note: detector-neutral: 1 m local maxima >= 3 m of the pit-free CHM smoothed by 0.3 m (the reference panels' numbering filter). Apexes, not trees; strata guide the choice of reference windows and are never scores.

rules.stratum: share of CHM >= 3 m in a 16 m square round the apex: isolated < 0.2, group < 0.45, edge < 0.75, closed otherwise
rules.leafOff: vegetated share of the leaf-off crown disc (1.5 + 0.15 h m): conifer-like >= 0.5, leafless < 0.2, mixed between
rules.play: near within 90 m of any hole line or practice area of norrfallsviken

warnings: closed canopy holds 42% of the apexes and the scan has 1.854 first returns/m2: touching crowns in closed stands will share maxima (Johannesberg: 1.8/m2 leaf-off, closed recall 17/23 and the 90% gate failed there). Put closed windows in the reference sample anyway, and record the stratified result.
the leaf-off photo is 1840 days from the laser: trees felled or grown between them will disagree; prefer the leaf-off campaign nearest the laser date
the laser is leaf-on: the conifer/broadleaf rule reads the leaf-off PHOTO, so it still applies, but broadleaf crowns will look denser in the CHM than at Johannesberg
